List all visible defects.
3. Categorize defects by type.
4. Take detailed photographs.
5. Describe each defect thoroughly.
6. Note the location of each defect.
7. Recommend immediate action if necessary.
8. Suggest long-term mitigation strategies.
9. Record environmental conditions.
10. Document inspection equipment used.
11. Review past repair records.
12. Include findings from non-destructive testing.
13. Consult with a structural engineer if warranted.
14. Provide a summary of the report.
15. Ensure the report is clear and concise.

1. **Start with the maintenance records:** Begin by reviewing any available maintenance history on the bridge. This includes records of previous inspections, repair work, and any modifications made to the structure.
